channel.title: Arcade World News and Guides
channel.description: Gaming news, retro guides, industry analysis and Arcade World updates.

item.title: GTA 6 Launch Reactions Are Strong, but 30 FPS Performance Divides Players
item.description: GTA 6 has launched to huge enthusiasm, but early player discussion is split by 30 FPS, base-console dips and Xbox Series S performance.

item.title: BioWare Is Closing as EA Cancels the Next Mass Effect
item.description: EA is closing BioWare and has ended early development on the next Mass Effect, reversing its public commitment to the project from last year.

item.title: Riders Republic Adds Offline Mode on December 9 as the Switch 2 Version Launches
item.description: Riders Republic will add an offline single-player mode to every platform on December 9, the same day Ubisoft launches the game on Switch 2.

item.title: OpenPS2BIOS 0.2 Offers an Experimental Open-Source PS2 BIOS for Emulators
item.description: OpenPS2BIOS 0.2 provides an MIT-licensed PS2 BIOS replacement for emulators, but current testing documents only limited menu access.

item.title: Squad Is Coming to PS5 and Xbox Series as a Free PS5 Alpha Begins October 16
item.description: Offworld is bringing Squad to PS5 and Xbox Series in 2027, with a free PS5 alpha running October 16-25 and opt-in console crossplay.

item.title: RimWorld 1.7 Leaves Unity for Waylith With Saves and Most Mods Intact
item.description: RimWorld 1.7 is testing Ludeon's Waylith engine with two-way save compatibility, broad mod support and major performance claims.

item.title: Ultimechs Multiplayer Ends October 20 as the VR Game Leaves Stores
item.description: Ultimechs will lose online multiplayer and leave VR stores on October 20, while its single-player mode remains available to existing owners.

item.title: Forza Horizon 6 Comes to PS5 on January 26 With Cross-Save and a Disc Edition
item.description: Forza Horizon 6 reaches PS5 on January 26, 2027 with cross-save, cross-play, a physical edition and two performance modes.

item.title: Gears of War: E-Day Launches on Xbox and PC With Game Pass Access
item.description: Gears of War: E-Day is now available on Xbox Series X|S and PC, with launch access through Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass.

item.title: Jagex Announces RS4, a New RuneScape MMO Built in Unreal Engine
item.description: Jagex has revealed RS4, an independent RuneScape MMORPG built in Unreal Engine that begins in Ashenfall and remains a few years from release.

item.title: Xbox Cuts 268 Roles and Moves Next Halo Development to Activision
item.description: Xbox is eliminating 268 roles while moving the next Halo to an Activision-led team and reorganizing Rare, Obsidian, Turn 10, Playground, and other studios.

item.title: Lufia I & II: The Sinistrals Saga Brings Both SNES RPGs to Modern Platforms in 2027
item.description: Taito's Lufia I & II collection is coming to PS5, Switch 2, Switch, and Steam in 2027, preserving the original pixel art with new play features.

item.title: Stellar Blade Switch 2 Demo Is Available Ahead of Its November 5 Launch
item.description: A free Stellar Blade Complete Edition demo is now on the Switch 2 eShop, giving players a direct way to judge the port's interpolated 60 FPS target before launch.

item.title: Diablo IV Launches on Switch 2 With Cross-Progression and a 40 FPS Mode
item.description: Diablo IV is now on Switch 2 for $69.99 with both expansions, cross-progression, touch menus and a 40 FPS mode, but it still requires internet.

item.title: Warcraft III: Reforged 3.0 Removes LAN and Makes the Remaster Always-Online
item.description: Warcraft III: Reforged now requires a constant internet connection and no longer offers LAN play, though Blizzard's Legacy client keeps both options.

item.title: Muramasa: Revenant Blades Launches February 4, 2027 on PS5, Switch 2, Switch, and PC
item.description: Vanillaware's Muramasa returns on February 4, 2027, combining the Vita release and Genroku Legends for modern consoles and Steam.

item.title: GTA 6 in 2026: Release Date, Leaks, Controversies and What Is Confirmed
item.description: GTA 6 is due November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, while leaks, an $80 price and a disc-free physical edition drive debate.

item.title: Xbox Will Publish Kojima Productions' PHYSINT After PlayStation Steps Away
item.description: Xbox will publish Kojima Productions' PHYSINT after PlayStation stepped away, but platforms and a release window remain unconfirmed.

item.title: Rain World Anthology Brings the Complete Game to PS5 and Switch 2 on February 18
item.description: Rain World Anthology will put the base game and both expansions on physical PS5 and Switch 2 media, with pre-orders targeting February 18, 2027.
